keyPoints.en: Count on your fingers while you sing.

problem.en: Five monkeys were jumping. One fell off. How many were left?
problem.hi: पाँच बंदर कूद रहे थे। एक गिर गया। कितने बचे?

question.en: Which word rhymes with "four": door or shoe?
question.hi: "four" की तुक किससे: door या shoe?

question.en: Who did Mama call when a monkey fell?
question.hi: बंदर गिरा तो मम्मी ने किसे बुलाया?

intro.en: Counting rhymes help us learn numbers: "One, two, buckle my shoe; three, four, knock at the door." "Five little monkeys jumping on the bed."
intro.hi: गिनती वाली कविताएँ संख्याएँ सिखाती हैं: "One, two, buckle my shoe; three, four, knock at the door." "Five little monkeys jumping on the bed."
